description: Use this when the person wants to pay a due charge on a case. Input: the case `id` and the `chargeId` from evictions_list_case_charges. Opens a hosted checkout for one due charge and returns its URL; asked again while that checkout is open, it returns the same URL. Give the URL to the person: paying is theirs to do, and no tool takes card details. Refused when the charge is not due or online payment is off. Do not use this to see whether a charge is paid (use evictions_list_case_charges). Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

chargeId.description: The id of a due charge on that case, from evictions_list_case_charges.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

name: evictions_get_payment_link
title: Payment link
